This '''traffic controller''' and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] coordinated take off and landing of starfighters on the flight deck of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was among the many pilots he assisted.

==Behind the scenes==
This character appears to be based on footage of a traffic controller seen on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
